title: Cosmic Dream Pathway
description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large profile of a dark-skinned woman with glowing constellation patterns on her face and hair, merging into a colorful cosmic cloud. Below her, a winding rainbow path leads toward a distant dark castle under a dramatic sunset sky, with a smaller stylized woman in patterned clothing walking the path and a large circular symbol in the background.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a large profile of a beautiful dark-skinned woman with glowing white constellation and golden symbols on her face, her silhouette dissolving into colorful cosmic clouds and swirls. A smaller stylized woman with patterned headwrap walks along a winding rainbow-colored path that leads to a gothic castle on a hill under a dramatic red and purple sunset. A large circular patterned sun symbol floats in the sky. Ethereal, vibrant, mystical atmosphere.
